dali.title: Not one message goes unanswered.
dali.body: A customer left waiting often moves on to a competitor. Dali answers Facebook, Instagram and website messages within seconds, gives the prices, hours and services you provided, and sends the booking link. It never promises a discount on its own and leaves decisions to you.

nova.title: Fewer customers forget to come.
nova.body: A customer who forgets leaves an empty slot and lost income. Nova reminds every booked appointment automatically by SMS from your own number. You don't have to write a single message.

ora.title: The work on your desk gets lighter.
ora.body: Contracts, official letters, reports and presentations take your time. Ora reads them, drafts them in formal language and reminds you before a deadline passes. It translates English documents into Mongolian and weighs decisions with you. Your customers and staff never deal with it: it works in a chat only you open. It does not give legal advice.
ora.sceneAlt: Ora's room: a closed room with no window, where she reads a document at her desk. A presentation board on the wall, a pinboard of reminders beside it, and her files behind her.

lines.text: Meeting at the bank tomorrow at 10. What should I have ready?
The deck, the financial summary and five questions to ask are ready.
The draft contract arrived in English.
Translated into Mongolian, with notes on two clauses.

does.title: Reading and drafting documents
does.text: Reads contracts, official letters and reports, and tells you briefly what they say and what to watch. Drafts new ones in proper professional register.

does.title: Preparing presentations
does.text: Builds the deck for a meeting, an investor or your own team, with the structure and the figures in place, so all that is left is to talk.

does.title: Keeping your dates
does.text: Tracks contract end dates, reporting days and payment schedules, and reminds you before one runs out.

does.title: Translating from English
does.text: Turns contracts, letters and invoices that arrive in English into Mongolian with the meaning intact, and explains them plainly.

does.title: Thinking a decision through
does.text: Lays out the advantages and the risks of each option, and suggests the questions to ask before you commit.

does.title: Yours alone
does.text: The documents and conversations you give her stay with you. Not your team, and not your customers.
